meta.title: The Broken Starship
meta.subtitle: 🚀 Your ship crashes on a strange moon after receiving a mysterious signal from deep space.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🚀 Emergency Landing
scenes.narrative:
Red warning lights flash across the cockpit as your ship shakes violently.

⚠️ A mysterious signal dragged your starship off course.

Now you've crash-landed on a cold silver moon.

Outside the cracked viewport you spot three possible paths:

✨ A glowing cave.
🏚 A ruined station.
⚙️ Your damaged engine room.

scenes.title: ✨ The Glowing Cave
scenes.narrative:
Blue crystals illuminate the cave walls.

Despite the frozen moon outside, the air here feels strangely warm.

👣 A trail of footprints disappears deeper into the darkness.

scenes.title: 🏚 The Ruined Station
scenes.narrative:
The station looks abandoned, but the doors still have power.

Dust drifts through flickering hallways.

💻 One computer screen still displays the same signal that caused your crash.

scenes.title: ⚙️ The Engine Room
scenes.narrative:
Smoke pours from the damaged engine core.

⚡ Sparks jump from broken wires while the ship computer warns that power is critically low.

Without a new energy source, your ship will never leave this moon.

scenes.title: 📋 The Old Logs
scenes.narrative:
The station logs reveal the truth.

🛰 The crew discovered an alien artifact buried beneath the moon.

The object broadcasts a signal designed to lure ships here.

The final warning reads:

"DO NOT ACTIVATE THE CORE."

scenes.title: 📦 The Storage Room
scenes.narrative:
You discover survival supplies, a laser cutter, and an old access card.

🔑 These tools could unlock deeper parts of the station.

scenes.title: 🤖 Security Drone
scenes.narrative:
A damaged security drone rolls from the shadows.

🔴 Its scanner locks directly onto you.

"Station identification required."

scenes.title: 💨 Narrow Escape
scenes.narrative:
You sprint through the corridor while laser blasts scorch the walls behind you.

⚡ You barely escape by diving through a broken doorway.

scenes.title: 🆘 Unexpected Help
scenes.narrative:
The drone pauses.

🟢 Its scanner changes from red to green.

Believing you are part of the repair crew, it opens a hidden elevator leading underground.

scenes.title: 🥚 The Nest
scenes.narrative:
You follow the footprints into a massive chamber filled with glowing eggs.

👁 A tall alien creature watches silently from the ceiling above you.

scenes.title: 💎 Crystal Power
scenes.narrative:
You carefully remove one glowing crystal from the cave wall.

⚡ Energy pulses through it.

This crystal could power your ship… but it also feels connected to the strange signal.

scenes.title: 👽 The Silent Ally
scenes.narrative:
The alien slowly lowers itself from the ceiling.

Instead of attacking, it gently accepts the crystal.

Then it points toward a hidden tunnel beneath the cave.

It wants you to stop the signal.

scenes.title: 🔬 The Hidden Lab
scenes.narrative:
Behind the sealed door sits a secret laboratory.

🧪 Research notes cover the walls.

The scientists were trying to control the artifact before it became unstable.

A monitor flashes:

"CORE OVERLOAD POSSIBLE."

scenes.title: 🌌 The Artifact Chamber
scenes.narrative:
Deep underground, a massive black artifact floats above the floor.

⚡ Every few seconds it releases a pulse of energy.

This is what pulled your ship across space.

scenes.title: 🔧 One Last Repair
scenes.narrative:
You install the crystal inside the engine core.

🚀 The ship roars back to life.

But outside, the moon begins trembling as the signal grows even stronger.

scenes.title: 📡 The Distress Signal
scenes.narrative:
You send a distress signal into deep space.

At first there is only static.

Then something answers.

👁 It is not human.

scenes.title: 🛸 Strange Rescue
scenes.narrative:
A gigantic alien ship appears above the moon.

💡 A beam of light surrounds your broken vessel.

You are rescued… but taken far beyond known space.

scenes.title: ✅ Signal Destroyed
scenes.narrative:
You shut down the artifact.

⚡ The chamber falls silent.

Above the moon, the storms finally fade.

No more ships will ever be pulled here again.

You survived as the explorer who ended the signal.

scenes.title: 🚀 Escape
scenes.narrative:
You launch your repaired ship and blast away from the moon.

🌌 Behind you, the signal continues pulsing through space.

You escaped.

But something down there is still waiting.

scenes.title: 🔍 The Discovery
scenes.narrative:
You escape with proof of alien technology.

🛰 Humanity will never view the universe the same way again.

But deep down, you wonder if the artifact should have remained hidden forever.

scenes.title: 💥 Engine Failure
scenes.narrative:
You attempt repairs without the proper equipment.

⚠️ The engine core overloads.

Your ship loses power completely.

You are stranded on the moon forever.

scenes.title: ⚡ Security Override
scenes.narrative:
You attack the drone.

But its armor is far too strong.

🔴 A single laser blast fills the hallway with red light.

Your mission ends there.

scenes.title: 🌑 The Nest Awakens
scenes.narrative:
The instant you touch the egg, the entire nest comes alive.

👁 Shapes begin moving in the darkness all around you.

You never escape the cave.

scenes.title: 🌀 The Void Opens
scenes.narrative:
You activate the artifact core.

🌌 A black portal tears open in reality itself.

The stars inside it do not belong to your universe.

Then the portal drags you inside.

scenes.title: 💀 The Cursed Fragment
scenes.narrative:
You secretly break off a piece of the artifact.

At first, nothing happens.

Then whispers begin echoing inside your helmet.

You leave the moon alive…

but the artifact leaves with you.
